inputs.text: Cinematic 16:9. Stylized 3D animated feature-film look: cute caricatured animals with oversized heads, big friendly expressive eyes, short stubby limbs, no sharp teeth shown; realistic soft fur texture, warm light. Cheerful, friendly mood. Inside a cosy underground burrow with roots hanging from the ceiling and warm light falling through the round entrance. Hux, a cute caricatured honey badger with stocky low body, oversized round head, black fur with a thick silver-white stripe from the top of his head down his back, small round ears with a small notch in the left ear, is fast asleep, curled up on a bed of dry grass, eyes closed, his belly rising and falling as he snores softly. Very subtle movement, slow gentle camera push-in, shallow depth of field. No music, no subtitles, no on-screen text.
